text:
mike: Observed goroutine leak in Go SDK generator streams when user cancels ctx (sdk v0.9.2). Cancelling context stops Recv loop but internal retry/handshake goroutine keeps running.

jess: Oof. Minimal repro?

mike: small test uses context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second) + GeneratorStream; test shows goroutine count stays high after timeout. gist: https://gist.example/leak.

alex: Likely internal backoff uses service-level ctx rather than request ctx. Two fixes: make internals inherit request ctx or add exported Close() to stop internals.

sandeep: Plan: short-term add resp.Close() that cancels internal cancelFunc and stops retry loops; include unit test asserting goroutines return to baseline. Long-term refactor to wire request ctx into internals. Will prepare PR and backport patch to 0.9.x.

ci-bot: CI for mike/gen-cancel-fix PR submitted (PR #789): initial tests queued.

jess: Good plan. Add example in docs showing both ctx-based cancel and explicit Close() pattern. Ping eng-runtime for review after PR.

mike: Thanks — PR created with Close() + test and example. Will monitor for flakes post-merge.
